name: @liujitcn/kratos-uni-app
description: Private uni-app x host for Kratos H5, WeChat Mini Program, and App.

scripts.dev:h5: pnpm run prepare:x && UNI_INPUT_DIR=. uni --mode development-h5
scripts.dev:mp-weixin: pnpm run prepare:x && UNI_INPUT_DIR=. uni -p mp-weixin --mode development
scripts.dev:app: pnpm run prepare:x && UNI_INPUT_DIR=. UNI_APP_X_VAPOR=true uni -p app --mode development
scripts.build:h5: pnpm run prepare:x && UNI_INPUT_DIR=. UNI_OUTPUT_DIR=../../../../backend/web/uni-app uni build --mode production-h5
scripts.build:mp-weixin: pnpm run prepare:x && UNI_INPUT_DIR=. uni build -p mp-weixin --mode production
scripts.build:app: pnpm run prepare:x && UNI_INPUT_DIR=. UNI_APP_X_VAPOR=true uni build -p app --mode production
